info.title: OpenAsy Wiki
info.description: The company's handbook: spaces from wiki.yaml, pages with every change kept, the search, reviews and policies people confirm they have read. Anyone signed in may call it; what they read, write and manage in each space follows the space's groups, with the product role as a floor (owners and admins manage every space, editors edit and viewers read every space).

patch.summary: Move a page, give it an owner, mark it a policy or a template
patch.description:
Content is changed with publish. owner: the owner or a space admin (anyone when the owner left). policy: space admins. space moves the page and those under it, with the editor role in both.

Needs the editor role in the page's space; a page the caller cannot read answers 404.

delete.summary: Delete a page with its history
delete.description:
Refused while pages are under it. A policy needs the admin role.

Needs the editor role in the page's space; a page the caller cannot read answers 404.

post.description:
baseRevision is the revision the change started from. When the page has changed since, both changes are merged block by block (paragraphs, headings, lists, tables). When both changed the same or neighbouring blocks, nothing is published: 409 edit-conflict carries both versions to choose from, and the revision to publish against.

Needs the editor role in the page's space; a page the caller cannot read answers 404.

notify.description: Who is told by email: nobody (a small fix), the page's followers (default) or everyone who can read it. For a policy, anything but none is a new version everyone is asked to read.
